name: KIC 7125569
description: Reference star KIC 7125569 used to normalise observables into relative space for the giant (RGB) granulation-radius relations. Replaces Perky (KIC 6106415), which anchors the published MS/SGB relations of arXiv:2605.26742.
provenance: Atmospheric parameters, radius and mass from APOKASC-3 Table 4 (EvolState=RGB, CatTab=Gold, SeisSource=WAvg, Nquar=18, numax=40.3307 muHz, Dnu=4.6357 muHz, M=1.0142 Msun). amp/charb are posterior medians of the Kepler-bolometric-corrected observables from the Granalyse fits of this star.
